If you make the deal, wipe the camera recordings: otherwise you'll later find them dead. The hideout then becomes one of your apartments.

**Spoiler:** with the deal, their fate is left open (Reed only says they were taken care of); if you follow Myers' advice, BARGHEST kills them.

name: Jacob Long
role: Squatter at the Kress Street hideout
appears: Lucretia My Reflection
note:
One of the two squatters in the Rindo Hotel hideout, on Elizabeth Kress Street, along with Taylor Gibbs, when you arrive with Myers in Lucretia My Reflection. If you make a deal with them instead of neutralizing them, they stay, you can talk to each of them, and the next morning Jacob is the one who points out Dogtown's first **airdrop**, at the Wild Blue Hotel. If you make the deal, wipe the camera recordings or you'll later find them dead. **Save before deciding.** The Kress Street hideout becomes a V apartment, with a bed, bathroom, wardrobe and stash.

**Spoiler:** he shares Taylor Gibbs' fate: with the deal his fate is left open; if you follow Myers' advice, BARGHEST kills him.

name: Yuri Bychkov
appears: Side job Balls to the Wall · Birds with Broken Wings (board)
note:
A BARGHEST officer and the man you have to frame in the side job **Balls to the Wall**. Do that job **before Firestarter**: afterwards it is unavailable and, if it is active, it fails. His photo is on the board of BARGHEST's top brass you see in the basement in Birds with Broken Wings, next to Hansen, Szabó, Murphy, Bennett, Robinson and Rinder; if you already took him out, his photo is crossed out with a red X. The wiki has an image of him from the in-game database, but doesn't list his English voice.

**Spoiler:** if you frame him in Balls to the Wall, he ends up dead or incapacitated.

name: Carl Robinson
appears: Birds with Broken Wings (board) · Dogtown gigs
note:
A BARGHEST officer nicknamed "Dodger". His nickname matches Mr. Hands' gig **Waiting for Dodger**, one of the Tier 2 gigs that open in Lucretia My Reflection, although the notes don't confirm he is its target. His photo is on the board of BARGHEST's top brass you see in the basement in Birds with Broken Wings: he is one of the three officers (with Yuri Bychkov and Leon Rinder) you can kill before that job, and if you did, his photo is crossed out with a red X. You need at least three of Mr. Hands' gigs to move on to Get It Together.

**Spoiler:** his fate depends on the gigs you do in Dogtown.

name: Leon Rinder
appears: Birds with Broken Wings (board) · Dogtown gigs
note:
A BARGHEST soldier who appears on the board of the militia's top brass you see in the basement in Birds with Broken Wings, next to Hansen, Szabó, Murphy, Bennett, Bychkov and Robinson. He is one of the three (with Yuri Bychkov and Carl Robinson) you can take out before that job, in Dogtown's side content; if you did, his photo is crossed out with a red X. The notes don't say which gig he appears in, so check Mr. Hands' gigs if you want to cross him off. The wiki doesn't list his English voice.

**Spoiler:** his fate depends on the Dogtown side content you do.

name: Albert Murphy
appears: Birds with Broken Wings (board) · Firestarter
note:
A BARGHEST officer, on the board of the top brass you see in Birds with Broken Wings. In Firestarter, after following Alex, you talk to Murphy: he escorts you, warns that BARGHEST suspects an FIA operation, rides the elevator with you and has you leave your weapons in the locker. If you forget to collect your gear on the way out, Mr. Hands returns it later for €$20,000 in Dirty Second Hands. On the Songbird path he shows up again in the market area as you escape: you can fight him or sneak past. Beat him and he drops his Iconic club **Murphy's Law** (if not, Herold Lowe sells it, on that path only).

**Spoiler:** on the Songbird path you kill him or dodge him; on the Reed path you never see him again and his fate is unclear.

name: Yoko Tsuru
appears: The Ride · Black Steel in the Hour of Chaos · Leave in Silence
note:
A netrunner who sells quickhacks and crafting specs at The Gift, in Kabuki Market (Watson). In Phantom Liberty she is Mr. Hands' netrunner in Black Steel in the Hour of Chaos: she is always available if you **pay Mr. Hands €$15,000**, and she delivers the data **in 10 hours** in Kabuki. Hear out her proposal and accept it: during the ambush you'll have to send Mr. Hands the site's coordinates, and that gets you the **MaxTac Mantis Blades**. She is also tied to the job This Corrosion, on the Reed path. English voice: Ren Hanami, who also voices Wakako.

**Spoiler:** she lives.

name: Jasper Collins
appears: Black Steel in the Hour of Chaos
note:
The netrunner of the MaxTac squad you face at the end of Black Steel in the Hour of Chaos, on the Reed path, along with Faye Russo, Asher Peterson and Dallas Foster. He attacks from the back line with quickhacks. If his hacks are wearing you down, take him out first. If you called Nix, the **Self-ICE** implant protects you; Carol's gift also helps. Reed fights at your side: use him to split the enemies' attention and don't let them surround you. Bring plenty of healing to the fight.

**Spoiler:** he dies in the fight against the squad.

name: Will Gunner
appears: Black Steel in the Hour of Chaos
note:
A 6th Street general who teams up with Reed in Black Steel in the Hour of Chaos, on Phantom Liberty's Reed path. At the start you talk to Reed and his crew, and Gunner recognizes you if you did the base-game job **Stadium Love**: if you solved it without violence, he compliments your gun handling; if it was violent, he has less kind things to say. It is dialogue only, with no effect on the job, but it shows the game remembers your Night City choices. The wiki doesn't list his English voice.

**Spoiler:** he lives.

name: Sachiko Kusama
appears: The Devil
note:
The professor in charge of V's studies on Arasaka's orbital station, in The Devil ending's epilogue, Where Is My Mind?. When you wake, she puts you through tests: reading text, solving a Rubik's cube, responding to keywords and the treadmill. Follow the guard, sleep, and step onto the treadmill when asked. After almost **30 days**, Kusama tells you the treatment isn't working, and Takemura (if you saved him) or Hellman (if not) offers you the Secure Your Soul program for the final decision. English voice: Cristina Valenzuela.

**Spoiler:** she lives; V's decision after her diagnosis closes the ending.

name: Cassidy Righter
appears: The Star
note:
The Aldecaldo clan's marksman, of the Bright family. At the camp in The Star ending he is shooting bottles at the southeast end: join his target practice and, if you hit **at least 12 of the 16 bottles in 15 seconds**, he gives you his Iconic revolver **Amnesty**. Crouch and aim before he says go; no second try is documented, so **save first**. Afterwards you hear him out with Carol while Mitch and Panam explain the smuggling-tunnel plan. English voice: Mikey O'Connor.

**Spoiler:** he survives: he and Carol peel off in the sandstorm to draw the drones away.

name: Weldon Holt
appears: The Peralez chain · You Know My Name
note:
Night City's acting mayor, of the Devolutionist Party, Jefferson Peralez's rival in the election. He covered up Mayor Lucius Rhyne's murder. In I Fought the Law, the computer at the Red Queen's Race points to him and to Han, and at the end of Dream On you can lie to Jefferson and blame Holt so he focuses on winning. In Phantom Liberty he is among the guests at the Black Sapphire party in You Know My Name. English voice: Dave B. Mitchell.

**Spoiler:** he lives and loses the election in every ending.

name: Nibbles
appears: Megabuilding H10 · Who Wants to Live Forever
note:
A stray cat at Megabuilding H10, V's building, that you can adopt as your apartment's pet; the wiki has the steps and the guide doesn't detail them. Nibbles isn't the only pet: in The Heist you can take the **Iguana Egg** from behind the tree trunk, next to the adult iguana, and after Playing for Time a bowl appears in your apartment; place it there and after **90 in-game days** V's iguana hatches (the bowl doesn't exist on PS4 or Xbox One; Switch 2 is unconfirmed). Both pets get a small echo in The Tower ending.

**Spoiler:** in The Tower, Rogue's credits message mentions Nibbles and the iguana if you adopted them.

name: Chester Bennett
appears: Birds with Broken Wings (board) · Run This Town
note:
A BARGHEST officer and Mr. Hands' puppet candidate to run Dogtown once Hansen dies. His photo is on the board of BARGHEST's top brass you see in the basement in Birds with Broken Wings. His role comes in **Run This Town**, the job Mr. Hands offers you after Firestarter, where the succession between him and Jago Szabó is decided. While that job is pending, no new Dogtown gigs open, and if you refuse it twice it fails. The wiki only has an image of him from the in-game database.

**Spoiler:** depending on how you resolve Run This Town, he ends up as Dogtown's leader or backs down.

name: Chang-Hoon Nam
appears: Gig: Wakako's Favorite · Black Steel in the Hour of Chaos
note:
A Japantown (Westbrook) netrunner you meet in Wakako Okada's gig **Wakako's Favorite**; he also sells quickhacks and crafting specs at his shop. In Phantom Liberty he is one of the netrunner options in Black Steel in the Hour of Chaos: you need to have done Wakako's Favorite with him alive. He delivers the data **after 12 hours** at his shop in Japantown, the longest wait of all the options. English voice: Josh Han.

**Spoiler:** the hack leaves him with **aphasia** and he leaves Night City after handing you the data.

name: Ruby Collins
role: Empathy club dancer in Chippin' In
appears: Chippin' In
note:
A dancer at an empathy club who appears in Chippin' In, while Johnny hunts for his Porsche and his gun. Johnny seduces her in his memories: it is an **encounter** you live through him, not a romance for V. After the car crash, Ruby writes "**Ebunike**", the clue that leads to the Ebunike Docks, where the Porsche ended up and Grayson is waiting. Chippin' In is part of Johnny and Rogue's chain, and your answers at the grave unlock Blistering Love and the secret ending.

**Spoiler:** if you spare Jeremiah Grayson at the docks, she is killed later.

name: Asher Peterson
appears: Black Steel in the Hour of Chaos
note:
An officer of the MaxTac squad you face at the end of Black Steel in the Hour of Chaos, on the Reed path, along with Jasper Collins, Faye Russo and Dallas Foster. He uses **Mantis Blades** and comes at you in melee. If his blades are reaching you, take him out first; if Collins' hacks are the problem, start with the netrunner. Don't let them surround you and use Reed to split their attention. If you chose Yoko and sent Mr. Hands the coordinates, you later receive a set of MaxTac Mantis Blades.

**Spoiler:** he dies in the fight against the squad.
